Lower Text: [All Turns] Effects can't trash [X Antibody] in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait in the hand.
Upper Text: While you have a Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Gain 1 memory, and add this card to the hand.
[Main] Place this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon without [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards.
